chunks: God does not forgive that compeers be ascribed to Him, and absolves all else whatsoever He will. And he who associates compeers with God has indeed wandered far astray.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between what God forgives and what He does not forgive regarding Shirk?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes Shirk as the only unforgivable sin by nature (dhatan), distinguishing it from other sins which are forgiven by God's grace (mashii'ah). It highlights the gravity of deviating from pure monotheism, a core tenet in Usul al-Din, and serves as a warning against subtle forms of associating partners with God in worship and sovereignty.
